covers probability mass functions and probability density functions [@hutchinson_wwu_ml_videos].

:::

5MinuteAI explains [discrete random variables](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=STcqHZyPRI8)
and [continuous random variables](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xP6uYaU-E0Y) in five minutes each,
following the University of Washington's CSE 312 [@fiveminuteai_probstat].
:::

-   @wikipedia_probability_density_function --- the PDF, its properties and its uses

-   @wikipedia_joint_probability_distribution --- joint, marginal and conditional distributions
